executive_summary: Analysis of recent critical vulnerabilities impacting web applications, network protocols, and infrastructure, focusing on practical remediation techniques for students building security portfolios.

signals.title: Apache Struts Command Injection
signals.what_changed: Dynamic Method Invocation enables arbitrary code execution via method prefix
signals.why_it_matters: Demonstrates remote code execution risk in legacy frameworks
signals.application: Create a controlled lab environment to test and patch the vulnerability using WAF rules

signals.title: ISC BIND Data Processing Error
signals.what_changed: TKEY queries can trigger denial of service through malformed data
signals.why_it_matters: Shows importance of validating inputs in network services
signals.application: Implement input sanitization and rate limiting in a lab simulation

signals.title: Strapi Cleartext Storage
signals.what_changed: Sensitive user data stored in plain text in admin panel queries
signals.why_it_matters: Highlights need for encryption at rest in modern applications
signals.application: Build a secure Strapi instance and practice encrypting sensitive fields

signals.title: ProFTPD Access Control Flaw
signals.what_changed: Improper access control allows read/write via cpfr and cpto commands
signals.why_it_matters: Teaches proper file permission management in web servers
signals.application: Configure strict directory permissions and disable dangerous methods in lab

signals.title: Citrix NetScaler Memory Buffer Issue
signals.what_changed: Improper memory boundary checks enable RCE or DoS
signals.application: Analyze logs and simulate exploitation attempts in a sandbox

experiment.title: Portable Struts RCE Lab
experiment.objective: Demonstrate and mitigate command injection in a controlled environment
steps: Clone Struts repository into a Docker container
Send crafted request with method:prefix to trigger RCE
Apply fix by disabling dynamic method invocation
expected_evidence: Successful shell command execution against the vulnerable endpoint
Prevention after disabling dynamic method invocation
experiment.stop_condition: RCE is successfully blocked by configuration changes

discarded: Higher severity vulnerabilities like MikroTik RouterOS and Apple CoreGraphics require extensive setup beyond 60 minutes
